Current header acquisition stays separate from original immutable receipts. Confirmed acknowledgement requires current facts and preserves newer drafts.
Known denials remove private input until admitted recovery. Scope/lifecycle owners cancel remote work and obsolete subscriptions.

Restrained English/Indonesian form and review copy; no HRIS behavior is ported to Starter.
